     7	/-- Standard bound for `k` accumulated relative errors of size at most `u`. -/

     7	/-- A binary reduction tree with data stored at its leaves. -/

    15	/-- Apply a function to every leaf while preserving the reduction shape. -/

    18	  | node left right => node (map f left) (map f right)

    20	/-- Number of internal nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path. -/
    21	def depth : Tree α → ℕ
    22	  | leaf _ => 0
    23	  | node left right => 1 + max left.depth right.depth

    25	/-- Number of leaves in a tree. -/
    26	def leafCount : Tree α → ℕ
    27	  | leaf _ => 1
    28	  | node left right => left.leafCount + right.leafCount

    30	/-- Exact real-valued sum represented by a reduction tree. -/
    31	def exactSum : Tree ℝ → ℝ
    32	  | leaf value => value
    33	  | node left right => left.exactSum + right.exactSum

    35	/-- Multiply every leaf in a tree by the same scalar. -/
    36	def scale (c : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ
    37	  | leaf value => leaf (c * value)
    38	  | node left right => node (scale c left) (scale c right)
